text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Rob Roy... Rob of the Red Hair. A rough 
outlaw, but deeply compassionate... Such a 
truly wonderful hero.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(What was he thinking before the battle... 
before heading into a battlefield he might 
not win? And—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Right. "Rob Roy"... Sharing the same name 
as him, what should I be feeling?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-Y-Yes! I'm sorry, I was 
daydreaming...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Am I nervous after all, I wonder... My 
body keeps shivering like brrr-brrr-brrr! 
every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...If I can't put up good results here, 
becoming a hero is nothing more than a 
pipe dream.

Zenno Rob Roy says that, but she doesn't 
seem tense at all. Rather—
choice_data_list: Aren't you just trembling with excitement?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still... it's true that I don't feel that 
chilly sensation in my fingertips like 
when I'm nervous.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Deep down in my chest... I feel like it's 
burning really hot."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I haven't become a hero just yet, 
but...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're right, though. All to become a 
hero.
